title: Schema Design Basics
description: Build the foundational mental model for data warehouse design: star vs snowflake schemas, fact table types, surrogate keys, grain definition, SCD Type 1 vs 2, and the OLAP vs OLTP distinction.
outcomes: You'll distinguish star from snowflake schemas, identify the right fact table type for a scenario, explain surrogate vs natural keys, choose between SCD Type 1 and 2, and declare a correct grain.
